handback.title: README install steps use the thin workflow
handback.summary: The README's install steps tell adopters to add one workflow and one settings file, not copy Dokima.
handback.user_story: Adopters following the README add only the thin workflow and settings file, never a copy of Dokima.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter follows the README's install steps, they add the thin workflow and settings file, never copying Dokima's folders.
acceptance_criteria.words: The README install steps (README.md:120-125) and docs/wiki/Installing.md stop telling adopters to copy `.github/workflows/` and `dokima/`.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The README is one fixed file with no input; the test also checks the new steps exist.
